intro: Na Pranam Neevenayya is the latest Telugu Christian song written, tuned & produced by Bro.Philliph Prakash, sung by Jessi and music composed by Mahi Madhan. This song was released on August 01, 2025 through PHILLIPH PRAKASH YouTube channel.
